items.finding: contains and delta shipped untested, including the delta arithmetic judgement.
items.fix: fixed: two tests cover contains and delta on both sides of the tolerance — and they caught a real bug, delta was being read as a plain equals because equals sorts first in ASSERT_KINDS; delta now wins when both keys are present

items.finding: toFlow dropped step.name, flow.description and flow-level variables that the schema allows.
items.fix: fixed: all three are carried, and flow variables now sit under the pack's variables in the resolution bag

items.finding: A test title promised an error and a fail but the fixture produced error and skipped.
items.fix: fixed: renamed to what it checks, and a new test with two independent steps produces a genuine error plus fail and asserts fail wins

items.finding: StepVerdict and FlowVerdict live in run.ts, not verdict/model.ts as the plan said.
items.fix: answered: they stay beside the interpreter that produces them while verdict/model.ts owns the severity algebra; the file header now says so and the deviation is in Progress

summary: Kernel stays pure (no Date.now/fs/net; latency and durations come only from the executor-reported duration; SubtleCrypto is deterministic and ADR-0015-compliant with no new dependencies), the flow AST and assertion vocabulary track ADR-0003's step kinds and assertion keys, error and fail never merge and the fail-outranks-error rollup order is documented in code matching architecture.md §6, ADR-0014's windowing/31-day cap is correctly absent from the scope model, and the script-step-refused-as-error behavior is a reasonable documented stand-in for the not-yet-built sandbox unit.
